simple.meaning: יְקַמְעָם (Yᵉqamʻâm) is a Hebrew word meaning “Jekamam , an Israelite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יְקַמְעָם (H3360) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Chronicles 23:19, with occurrences in 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יְקַמְעָם (H3360) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יְקַמְעָם (H3360) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: יְקַמְעָם (Yᵉqamʻâm) / H3360 is traced through 1 Chronicles 23:19, 1 Chronicles 24:23 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H3360. Yeqamam יְקַמְעָם proper name, masculine (= עָם יָ֫קֶם according to Ol § 277 i ; meaning then may kinsman establish , compare Gray Prop. N. 46 f. 59); — a Levite 1Chr 23:19 ; 24:23 , Ικεμιας, Ιοκομ ( 24:23 ), etc., ᵐ5 L Ιακαμιας.
